titles.title: 505 I Cast All My Cares Upon You

songbook.name: I Cast All My Cares Upon You

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
I cast all my cares upon you.
I lay all of my burdens down to your feet.
And anytime that I don’t know what to do,
I cast all my cares upon you. (bis)
I cast all my cares upon you.
